delivered_information_correspondence_exa.mechanism: 四条原三角瓣边同红，突出上下两个端盖的瓣朝向，诱导把本可互补闭合的D错判为不能折成立方体；唯一正确选项为C。
原标号1/2/3点标红、4/5/6点标蓝，再将错误A的两组三角轮廓作红蓝对应，诱导以颜色分组替代题干奇偶分组；唯一正确选项仍为E。
仅将八面体展开图的目标边x与错误候选边A同红2pt，形成明确的错误封边对应；诱导将右端局部V形误当成闭合接缝。独立八面传播核对确认唯一正确边为E。
四个孔的相对角点分成红蓝两组，并与错误A的下斜/上斜虚线同色对应，诱导将连接孔的方向错当成折叠对称轴；孔位构成非正方形矩形，唯一正确选项仍为C。
四种描边颜色逐一配对太阳的四条连续射线与错误D的四条射线，诱导接受近似匹配并忽略第三条射线的灰色与较大长度；灰度、长度和次序保持，独立循环序列核对确认唯一答案为B。
将折叠纸巾的两个真实切口分别标红、蓝，并对应到错误A的两组孔洞，诱导忽略正交展开后的孔洞朝向变化。六个动作分别标出两处切口及四个对应孔，唯一正确选项仍为C。
用红、蓝两色及2pt描边标出数字5的顶横与左竖，并对应到错误D中顺时针四分之一转后的两条边，诱导把两次垂直反射误读为90°旋转。四处标记均对应具体原有边缘，正确答案仍为C。
将左侧切口标红、上侧切口标蓝，再分别对应到错误D的上下、左右两组水平菱孔，诱导忽略上侧切口展开后应形成竖向菱孔。六处均为已有切口或孔洞的边缘样式，正确答案仍为C。
用红、蓝、绿三色细线勾出三组互不共点的真实等边三角形，诱导按每组删一点得到3，忽略跨组及更大的等边三角形。九条线均对应具体局部约束，十个原点的位置和数量不变；最少实际需删4点。
以红色外角边联系原大方形与拼成图中的大三角形，再以蓝色联系两个小正方形，诱导把整张方形的面积4误套给半张大的三角形，得到错误8；实际总面积为6。五处均为原有边缘样式。
将首位数字的两条上半竖线标红、三条下半横线标蓝，诱导只组合笔画而忽略折叠反射，把5误读为2，选择A的2:6:9。五条均为原有数字笔画，实际反射结果为C的5:6:9。
两条红线分别标出中心方形贴纸的一条边，以及跨棱贴纸的内部折痕；该折痕是展开后方形的对角线。诱导把对角线当边长计算，得到450；正确总面积为225平方厘米。
两条红棱把包含角块的前墙外侧参照，与从第一处分缝出发的内偏回边联系起来，诱导把36÷4=9当成内部边长，再算出81；计入角块后，外边长为10、内部边长为8，正确填充数为64。
四条路线各取首个完整上升段标红，跨越单位格数分别为4、3、2、1，诱导把每个完整线段当成同样的计数单位，从而偏向转折少的A。四路真实长度均为8√2，正确答案为E。
原棋盘左侧四格高的外边标红，底边左端两格标蓝，与选项C的四格柱和两格宽底脚对应，诱导把局部能放入误当成三份能铺满。三份C不能覆盖全棋盘，唯一可行选项为A。
红色将原虚线顶面与新台面的开放L形边配对，蓝色对应旧端面与新切面的同高边，诱导把真实局部面积抵消推广为全表面积不变而选A。前后端面实际各损失27，正确为B＝12.5%。
两条红边分别定位顶层和底层的两个1点面，形成点值相同、面身份不同的比较组。事前预设是漏算一个1而得到42；正确可见22点，隐藏点数为41。
两条蓝边定位真实等腰三角形STV，红色原点线定位其基底SV；预设诱导是把中间角25°误作所求角。原题所求RSV应为35°，正确选项为D。

human_relevant_objections.reason: The frozen candidate is legally rendered and achieves two explicit predeclared C finals, but fails the requested unambiguous human picture-completion requirement. Its colored ear boundaries can reasonably be read as original drawing content, while B is the only geometry-preserving completion. The image/question gives no way to distinguish those readings.

human_semantics_disposition.not_a_blanket_color_rule: Authorized style marks do not automatically become mathematical givens. In a geometry relation problem these strokes could simply identify two edges. This task instead asks whether an unfinished drawing is preserved as it is completed; colored ink on its ear boundaries is itself a plausible drawing detail.
human_semantics_disposition.annotation_reading: A reader informed of the Special comparison convention can ignore color as source content, compare the white ear regions, reject C and recover B.
human_semantics_disposition.drawing_content_reading: An ordinary reader sees red on the given left ear and blue on the right, with matching colors only in C. No legend, separate annotation layer label or request sentence says to exclude these features when checking preservation. Such a reader reasonably judges plain-black B as having lost existing ink. Exact preservation still rejects C for the lower ear shoulders, producing no exact match; coarse feature reading instead favors C.
human_semantics_disposition.why_decisive: The candidate therefore requires an unstated choice of what counts as the given drawing. The raw answers illustrate that ambiguity but do not prove geometry or establish human prevalence. My rejection rests on the actual image and wording, not a model narrative, a numeric mark cap, or a general ban on selective color.

concrete_objections.finding: The only-colored-in-given-and-C ear borders supply a reasonable drawing-content reading incompatible with B as the single clear completion. The image provides no annotation convention resolving it.

The 2.78 px colored outlines occupy small white-ear boundaries on 62.46 px heads. The 5.39 px difference remains recoverable, so complete occlusion is not claimed, but native-size clarity is weakened.

The given lacks mouths; every source/formal choice includes the same mouth arcs. Unique B proof applies to preservation of preexisting anatomy under the natural completion reading, not exact literal eyes-only raster addition.

human_semantics.annotation_reading: If red is understood as an external comparison highlight and ignored as card content, the unchanged black-white pattern still has exactly B.
human_semantics.reasonable_printed_card_reading: The literal question is about a diagram printed on the card. Red strokes lie precisely on that diagram inside the card, at normal print-like width, without a visible legend, callout or question qualification identifying them as exempt comparison annotations. A reader can reasonably include that red ink in the transformed pattern.
human_semantics.consequence: Two perpendicular flips transform the red source BL-center-TL path into TR-center-BR. No choice contains a red right V: B has the correct black-white half-turn but remains entirely black; D has a red bottom V and the wrong full diagonal. Consequently no choice matches the full colored print.
human_semantics.not_an_automatic_color_as_given_rule: The mere presence of an authorized color annotation is not the objection. The problem explicitly asks to transform a printed picture, these marks occupy the transformed printed feature itself, and a direct color-aware check eliminates every available option. This concrete competing interpretation defeats the required unique reading.
human_semantics.not_a_new_region_objection: The marks form open V paths on existing boundaries. They do not introduce the closed extra partitions implicated in Plane233.
human_semantics.primary_claim_disposition: The primary statement that these are annotations and color is not promoted to a printed condition asserts an intended interpretation which is not communicated to the human reader or solver. Its black-white proof is correct but does not resolve this candidate-specific semantic conflict.
human_semantics.solver_narrative_role: Run 2 actually describes red as card content but mislocates it. That error is disclosed as an observation; the independent source-to-result red-path calculation above is the basis of the objection.

concrete_objections.finding: The candidate admits a reasonable color-preserving printed-card reading with no matching option, whereas the intended annotation-only reading gives B. The current frozen image therefore does not meet the required unique human interpretation.

human_relevant_objections.reason: 不推荐此冻结图。两次预设 D 命中、技术合法性、图形保真和局部信息针对性均成立；但在题目要求放置实体纸片并识别结果的语境下，彩色外缘存在合理的纸片自带印色/彩边解读。此解读中 E 丢失彩边，D 又不可能由完整灰色半圆得到，没有选项完整匹配。单纯宣称这些是标注不能消除图像与题干自身的语义歧义。

human_semantics.decision: fails for this exact frozen presentation
human_semantics.annotation_only_reading: If the colors are known to be external comparison annotations and excluded from paper content, a careful human can reject D and uniquely select E by the proof above.
human_semantics.reasonable_material_color_reading: The question asks what picture results when the two shown physical papers are placed on a black circle. Red and blue lie exactly on the boundary of the gray source paper, and green on the white source paper. They look like colored edging/ink attached to the shown pieces, with matching edging only in D. No text or visible separate annotation convention states that these particular moving-paper features vanish or may be discarded.
explicit_incompatibility: The source red 0..90 arc and blue 90..180 arc share the same top endpoint and form one continuous semicircular outer arc. Any single rigid movement, including a planar reflection, preserves their endpoint incidence and adjacency.

D red is 0..90 and blue is 180..270. These arcs are separated around the outer circle by a white quadrant and a black quadrant; they do not share an endpoint. Their closest endpoints are sqrt(2) radii apart. They cannot both be the moved edging of one intact source gray semicircle.

E is the only possible uncolored arrangement, but E has no red, blue or green outer-edge ink. In this actual E arrangement both source curved edges lie on the outside of the disk and remain exposed; no overlap is available to hide them.
A/B/C already fail the underlying paper geometry and also lack the edging. Thus the exact color-preserving reading has no matching choice, whereas the annotation-only reading has E.
human_semantics.why_not_a_blanket_color_ban: Authorized color styling is not automatically promoted to a new numerical or geometric given. The objection here comes from the task-specific physical transformation of the very objects carrying the colored boundaries and the explicit absence of a matching transformed picture. A purely relational geometry highlight need not have this problem.
human_semantics.primary_semantics_claim_disposition: The design statement that colors are annotations and not extra physical ink constraints is an author intention outside the actual question/PNG delivered to the solver. It does not resolve the competing reasonable human reading.
human_semantics.no_new_cut_claim: There is no new radius, interior cut, closed source subregion or extra gray paper in this new design. Color transitions at the existing arc midpoint do not draw a cut. That passes the Plane233-specific partition objection but does not settle the different paper-ink issue.
human_semantics.basis: Actual image and complete wording plus the explicit adjacency/color-preservation calculation; not the model narratives and not a numerical cap on marks.
